# Wayback Machine

> A comprehensive digital archive enabling access to historical snapshots of websites and internet content spanning decades of web history.

The Wayback Machine, operated by the Internet Archive, is the primary tool for web preservation and historical content access. It maintains millions of archived web pages, allowing users to explore how websites appeared at specific points in time and discover digital materials including audio collections, images, vintage software, and more.

- Internet Archive

## Core Archive Services

- [Wayback Machine](https://web.archive.org): Internet Archive's Wayback Machine: digital web preservation and historical content access

## Archived Websites

- [DAVIDLYNCH.COM](https://web.archive.org/web/20080303234450/http://www.davidlynch.com/): Archived 2008 snapshot of David Lynch's official website via Wayback Machine
- [Spectra Animation](https://web.archive.org/web/20090206093601/http://spectra-animation.ca/): Archived 2009 snapshot of Spectra Animation studio website via Wayback Machine
- [Welcome to www.wearelittlestars.com](https://web.archive.org/web/20020331023129/http://wearelittlestars.com/): Archived 2002 snapshot of wearelittlestars.com website via Wayback Machine
